intent.raw: Prepare another context/product migration because Craft is receiving work, not being migrated.
intent.objective: Produce one validated planning candidate for migrating the Ontology Product and explicitly coordinating its existing Bounded Contexts while Craft receives the work.

subagent_strategy.explanation: The route is a bounded sequential planning pass with one canonical author and deterministic validators; independent delegated work is not needed.

steps.name: Inventory genuine Product and Bounded Context identities

inputs.ref: cyberAlchemy-v2 and CyberAlchemy-lab selected identity records

stop_conditions: stop if no genuine Product identity can be distinguished from capabilities and contexts

steps.name: Distill the migration subject and first unit
convergence_criteria: the first unit is reversible and recomposes into the complete migration
stop_conditions: stop if the chosen subject collapses Product, Capability, Bounded Context, or Craft work-receiver identity

steps.name: Author the layered Product/Context migration plan
stop_conditions: stop if any internal stage requests approval
stop if the plan claims implementation or lifecycle authority

steps.name: Validate canonical records and generated projections
stop_conditions: stop on canonical schema, source epoch, projection, layering, orthogonality, or approval-boundary failure

gates.owner: CyberAlchemy v2 product owner and Lab architecture owner
gates.condition: Ontology Product is the migration subject; Craft remains only the work receiver; contexts and capabilities retain distinct identities.

gates.owner: definitions-governance and CyberAlchemy v2 product owner
gates.condition: The three current source drifts remain explicit blockers to Product copying and are routed to L0.
Only the immutable integrated L4 candidate may request product approval; all later authority effects remain separate.

boundaries.contract: Read exact source bytes and record paths, sizes, digests, status, and residue; do not copy or reinterpret source meaning during planning.
Expose five work items for later Craft intake without mutating Craft or transferring Product, Context, or source authority.
One approval question is eligible only after an immutable L4 candidate passes; planning validation is not approval.

authority.lifecycle: respective Product, Context, Context Map, artifact-type, and source owners
authority.promotion: human Product decision owner at L4 only

promotion_guardrails: Planning and validation create no implementation, Product, Context, admission, publication, release, deployment, or source-retirement authority.
Current source BLOCK cannot be described as PASS or bypassed by copying stale source records.
Craft work intake cannot change the semantic owner of the migrated Product or its Bounded Contexts.
